name: line-shadow-text
title: Line Shadow Text
description: A line of large white text where one word is set in italic and carries a diagonal striped shadow behind it, slowly sweeping across on a loop.
use: A hero headline needs one word to feel alive without pulling attention from the copy.
avoid: Long text: the effect only suits a short, very large word or two.
a11y: It is real text with decorative styling, so it reads fine; the endless loop ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two oversized white words on black, an upright one followed by an italic one. Behind the italic word sits a fine diagonal-stripe shadow of the same letters, offset slightly down and right.
behaves: The hatched shadow drifts diagonally across the italic word on a long fifteen-second loop, so the streaks seem to slide and gather behind the letters. The text itself stays still.
customise: Pass the word as a child and choose the shadow colour; the stripe angle, density and fifteen-second timing are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One text node with a CSS background-position keyframe; no canvas or script loop.
